title: The Coast That Grows the More You Measure It
summary: A translation of the same day's science episode: the length you get for a coastline depends on the length of the ruler you measure it with, and the total keeps growing as the ruler gets shorter instead of settling on one number. The episode starts with Lewis Fry Richardson noticing that Spain and Portugal reported different lengths for their shared border. It follows the idea to Mandelbrot's nineteen sixty-seven paper How
